flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4700/ then assert that the app's home page loads with real content.
Then navigate directly to http://127.0.0.1:4700/login . This is the request a browser sends when a visitor presses refresh on that page, or opens a link to it that a friend shared.
Assert that the page shows the app's login screen (a sign-in form).
Assert that the page is not a host error page such as "404: NOT_FOUND" or "Page not found".

summary:
Opened the app and confirmed its home page displayed normal lending content.
Navigated directly to the shared login link at http://127.0.0.1:4700/login.
The login page loaded successfully with email and password fields and a Sign In button, without a not-found error page.
one_liner: opened the login page on the local LendWise app
